name: omnibase/booking
description: Stays booking for omnibase sites, built on omnisense/omnistay: hosts' listings with their calendars (blocked nights, minimum stays, prices per night and season), bookings held without double booking (symfony/lock) and paid through omnisense/omnitrade, reviews in both directions, guest-host messages, host payouts, and the back office - the site's own listings searched beside the hotels of other omnistay providers (omnistay/amadeus).

suggest.omnisense/omnitrade: the payment of a booking (omnitrade/stripe: Stripe Checkout)
suggest.omnistay/amadeus: hotels searched beside the site's listings
suggest.omnisense/omnitravel: the journey to the stay (a later step)
